interface.signature: def isPossible(N: int, P: int, prerequisites: list[set[int]]) -> bool:

preconditions.description: N is the number of tasks (1 ≤ N ≤ 10^4), P is the number of prerequisite pairs (1 ≤ P ≤ 10^5), and each prerequisite pair is a set of two distinct integers representing a directed edge from the second to the first task.

preconditions.expression: all(len(pair) == 2 and all(0 <= task < N for task in pair) for pair in prerequisites)
preconditions.description: Each prerequisite pair contains exactly two distinct task labels in the range [0, N-1].

postconditions.expression: return_value == (not any(task in cycle for task in range(N)) for cycle in find_cycles(build_graph(N, prerequisites)))
postconditions.description: The function returns true if and only if the directed graph formed by the prerequisites has no cycles, meaning all tasks can be completed in a valid topological order.
